nodes.name: Email Me the Error

parameters.subject: ={{ '⚠ Meta Purchase tracking FAILED - ' + $json.workflow.name }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'A $197 training purchase may NOT have been reported to Meta.

Workflow: ' + $json.workflow.name + '
Failed step: ' + ($json.execution.lastNodeExecuted || 'unknown') + '
Error: ' + (($json.execution.error && $json.execution.error.message) || 'unknown') + '
When: ' + $now.setZone('America/New_York').toFormat('ff') + ' ET

Open the failed run: ' + ($json.execution.url || 'n/a') + '

To resend the purchase after fixing the cause: open that run, click the retry arrow, choose Retry with currently saved workflow.

Common causes:
- Meta error 190 / 401: the access token expired or was revoked. Generate a new one in Events Manager and update the Header Auth credential.
- Missing Email: GHL sent a payload with no email. Check the webhook action in GHL Workflow 2.
- Meta 400: read the error above for the field Meta rejected.' }}

nodes.notes: Needs an SMTP credential. Set From and To before activating.
